issues.on_page: Local Receipts -- 0% 10-Year EDGE Loan plus Interest 60,842.02

The extractor's review note assumes loan repayments, but the line is most likely debt proceeds plus investment income, not 'other' revenue. It is 87% of the year's non-transfer receipts. Only a person can settle this.
